entries.name: hunt-ssti
entries.description: Hunt server-side template injection (SSTI) across Jinja2 (Flask/Django), Twig (Symfony), Freemarker (Java), ERB (Rails), Spring, Velocity, Mako, Thymeleaf, Smarty. Detection probes use double-curly and dollar-curly math expressions evaluated server-side. Once an engine is fingerprinted, escalate to RCE via the engine-specific class-walker, callback-registrar, or Execute-utility patterns documented in disclosed reports. Detection patterns: error messages reveal engine, blank or numeric eval reveals expression mode. Targets: email templates, PDF/report generators, CMS preview features, error pages with user input. Use when hunting RCE via template rendering, when content shows engine fingerprints, when finding endpoints that compose strings with user input before render.

entries.name: hunt-subdomain

Use when hunting subdomain takeover — emphasis on ATO-chain primitives (OAuth `redirect_uri`, cookie-domain, email DNS).

entries.name: meme-coin-audit

entries.name: mid-engagement-ir-detection
entries.description: Methodology for detecting client SOC patches, attacker activity, and security-state changes that occur DURING a red-team engagement — and converting those observations into deliverable findings. Use when (a) running ANY active engagement against a monitored target, (b) a previously-confirmed finding stops reproducing, (c) baseline timing shifts unexpectedly, or (d) you notice response patterns changing during testing.

entries.name: offensive-osint
entries.description: Operational arsenal for authorized external red-team and bug-bounty recon. Concrete probes, wordlists, regexes, dorks, curl one-liners for: subdomain enum, GraphQL/Swagger/REST discovery, identity fabric (Entra/Okta/ADFS/Google/SAML/M365 deep — Teams/SharePoint/OneDrive), cloud bucket enum (S3/GCS/Azure), CDN/WAF bypass, origin discovery, vendor fingerprinting (Citrix/F5/Pulse/Fortinet/PaloAlto/Cisco/VMware), CI/CD exposure, 48-pattern secret-scan catalog (AWS/GCP/GitHub/Stripe/Slack/Anthropic/OpenAI/Atlassian/DataDog/npm/PyPI), Postman workspaces, breach correlation (HudsonRock/HIBP/DeHashed/IntelX), TLS/JA3 audit, certificate transparency, JS endpoint extraction, package registry leaks, mobile/APK recon, sat imagery, sector-specific recon (healthcare DICOM, finance SWIFT, ICS/SCADA Modbus/BACnet). entries.name: osint-methodology
entries.description: Comprehensive OSINT methodology for external red-team operations and authorized attack-surface assessments. Covers the 5-stage recon pipeline (seed discovery, asset expansion, enrichment, exposure analysis, reporting), asset-graph discipline with 29 asset types, severity rubric (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFO), confidence upgrade workflows, time budgeting, asset-level triage rules, scale-based tactics, identity-fabric mapping (Entra/Okta/ADFS/Google/SAML/M365 Teams+SharePoint+OAuth), API and auth-map methodology, JavaScript deep analysis, mobile attack surface, cloud attack surface, breach×identity correlation, detectability tagging, detection-aware probing (back-off, persona rotation), read-only validator discipline, WAF/CDN bypass + origin discovery, vulnerability prioritization (CVE/EPSS/KEV), phishing infrastructure planning + pretext development, bug bounty submission templates, client deliverable templates with risk translation, threat-actor investigation (incl. RU/CN pivots), cryptocurrency tracing, image/video forensics, chronolocation. Use when planning or executing reconnaissance against authorized targets, mapping an organization's external attack surface, investigating a person/entity, tracing crypto flows, geolocating media, or performing attribution work.

The single most important skill to load when scope is "external red team" not "bug bounty / WAPT".

Different audience, different tone, different cadence. Built from an authorized engagement deliverable where 14 findings were packaged into a 52KB MD + 2.2MB DOCX with 16 embedded screenshots. Use when the engagement is "external red team for an enterprise client" (not H1/Bugcrowd/Intigriti), when generating the final report, when the client has specified a custom report format, or when packaging findings into DOCX/PDF.

entries.name: report-writing

entries.name: vmware-vcenter-attack
entries.description: VMware vSphere / vCenter Server external attack matrix — version fingerprinting, the high-impact CVE chain (CVE-2021-21972 vRealize unauth file upload, CVE-2021-21985 vSAN plugin RCE, CVE-2022-22954 Workspace ONE SSTI, CVE-2023-20887 Aria RCE, CVE-2024-37085 ESXi AD bypass, CVE-2023-34048 vCenter DCERPC OOB write APT-exploited), default credentials, SSO configuration disclosure, vmdir LDAP enumeration, ESXi Open SLP RCE history. TRIGGER when the user says "aggregate my agent logs for paper writing", "extract experiments from my coding agent history", "prepare PaperOrchestra inputs from my cache", "turn my agent logs into a paper", mentions a folder or directory they want to use as the basis for a paper, or wants to run PaperOrchestra but only has scattered agent experiment histories rather than structured inputs. Run this BEFORE paper-orchestra. Also called automatically by paper-orchestra when workspace/inputs/idea.md or workspace/inputs/experimental_log.md are missing.

entries.name: content-refinement-agent
entries.description: Step 5 of the PaperOrchestra pipeline (arXiv:2604.05018). Iteratively refine drafts/paper.tex by simulating peer review and applying targeted revisions, with strict accept/revert halt rules. Maintains a worklog and snapshots each iteration so revert is real, not symbolic. TRIGGER when the orchestrator delegates Step 5 or when the user asks to "refine the draft", "iterate on the paper", or "run peer review on this paper".

entries.name: literature-review-agent
entries.description: Step 3 of the PaperOrchestra pipeline (arXiv:2604.05018). Execute the literature search strategy from outline.json — discover candidate papers via web search, verify them through Semantic Scholar (Levenshtein > 70 fuzzy title match, temporal cutoff, dedup by paperId), cross-corroborate against Crossref + OpenAlex to flag hallucinated citations, build a BibTeX file, and draft Introduction + Related Work using ≥90% of the verified pool. Runs in parallel with the plotting-agent. TRIGGER when the orchestrator delegates Step 3 or when the user asks to "find citations for my paper", "draft the related work", or "build the bibliography".

entries.name: outline-agent
entries.description: Step 1 of the PaperOrchestra pipeline (arXiv:2604.05018). Convert (idea.md, experimental_log.md, template.tex, conference_guidelines.md) into a strict JSON outline containing a plotting plan, literature search plan (Intro + Related Work), and section-level writing plan with citation hints. TRIGGER when the orchestrator delegates Step 1 or when the user asks to "outline a paper from raw materials" or "generate the paper structure".

entries.name: paper-autoraters
entries.description: Run the four paper-quality autoraters from PaperOrchestra (arXiv:2604.05018, App. F.3) — Citation F1 (P0/P1 partition + Precision/Recall/F1), Literature Review Quality (6-axis 0-100 with anti-inflation rules), SxS Overall Paper Quality (side-by-side), and SxS Literature Review Quality (side-by-side). TRIGGER when the user asks to "score this paper draft", "evaluate against the benchmark", "compare two papers", or "run the autoraters".

entries.name: paper-orchestra
entries.description: Orchestrate the full PaperOrchestra (Song et al., 2026, arXiv:2604.05018) five-agent pipeline to turn unstructured research materials (idea, experimental log, LaTeX template, conference guidelines, optional figures) into a submission-ready LaTeX manuscript and compiled PDF. TRIGGER when the user asks to "write a paper from my experiments", "turn this idea and these results into a paper", "generate a conference submission", "run paper-orchestra on X", or otherwise wants the end-to-end paper-writing pipeline. Coordinates the outline-agent, plotting-agent, literature-review-agent, section-writing-agent, and content-refinement-agent skills.

entries.name: paper-writing-bench
entries.description: Reverse-engineer raw materials (Sparse idea, Dense idea, experimental log) from an existing AI research paper to build a benchmark case for evaluating paper-writing pipelines. Replicates the PaperWritingBench dataset construction procedure from arXiv:2604.05018 §3 / App. C. TRIGGER when the user asks to "build a benchmark case from this paper", "reverse-engineer raw materials", or "evaluate my pipeline against PaperWritingBench".

entries.name: plotting-agent
entries.description: Step 2 of the PaperOrchestra pipeline (arXiv:2604.05018). Execute the visualization plan from outline.json — render plots and conceptual diagrams from experimental_log.md and idea.md, optionally refine via VLM critique loop, and produce context-aware captions. Runs in parallel with the literature-review-agent. TRIGGER when the orchestrator delegates Step 2 or when the user asks to "generate the figures for my paper" or "render the plots from this experiment log".

entries.name: section-writing-agent
entries.description: Step 4 of the PaperOrchestra pipeline (arXiv:2604.05018). ONE single multimodal LLM call that drafts the remaining paper sections (Abstract, Methodology, Experiments, Conclusion), extracts numeric values from experimental_log.md into LaTeX booktabs tables, splices the generated figures from Step 2, and merges everything into the template that already contains Intro + Related Work from Step 3. TRIGGER when the orchestrator delegates Step 4 or when the user asks to "write the methodology and experiments sections" or "fill in the rest of the paper".

FILL (complete form fields): "fill in the form", "fill out this PDF", "complete the form fields", "write values into PDF", "what fields does this PDF have". This skill uses a token-based design system: color, typography, and spacing are derived from the document type and flow through every page. The output is print-ready. Prefer this skill when appearance matters, not just when any PDF output is needed.

entries.name: destruction-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all assumption destruction outputs into structured destructive innovation report.

entries.name: detection-scoring
entries.description: Rate detectability 1-10 (inverted: 10 = hardest to detect). Estimates how likely current controls would catch the failure before impact.

entries.name: devils-advocacy
entries.description: Construct the strongest possible counter-argument against a position, steelmanning the opposition before attacking.

entries.name: dialectical-escalation
entries.description: Double-loop learning escalation — surface governing variables, generate counter-assumptions, test if problem dissolves under alternatives, score wickedness if it persists.

entries.name: dialectical-reformulation
entries.description: Surface Argyris governing variables and test whether the problem dissolves under alternative governing variables (double-loop learning).

entries.name: dialectical-synthesis
entries.description: Hegelian thesis-antithesis-synthesis cycle — propose position, generate opposition, structured debate, synthesize transcending insight. Combines evaporating-cloud and polarity-mapping SOPs.

entries.name: dimension-assessment
entries.description: Score a single readiness dimension for a candidate with evidence and gap analysis.

entries.name: direct-analogy
entries.description: Find structurally similar systems in nature/technology/society. Map structural parallels to generate transferable solution principles.

entries.name: direct-analogy-generation
entries.description: Find direct analogies from nature/tech/society that share structural properties with the problem. Produces analogy list with structural mappings.

entries.name: direction-narrowing
entries.description: Focus within the user's chosen field(s). Identify specific sub-directions through deep paper and web research, then present ranked candidates. Use after landscape-reconnaissance has identified fields of interest.

entries.name: disagreement-cartography
entries.description: Map the structure of disagreement across perspectives using Policy Delphi, Argument Delphi, or SAST methods.

entries.name: disagreement-mapping
entries.description: Map disagreement structure by collecting judgments, clustering opinions, extracting arguments per cluster, and visualizing fault lines.

entries.name: disagreement-visualization
entries.description: Produce a structured disagreement map showing clusters, arguments, and fault lines.

entries.name: discrepancy-analysis
entries.description: Identify discrepancies between reported and reproducible scores — 15 methods, 45 data points, 30 web searches budget

entries.name: discrepancy-identification
entries.description: Compare same-method scores across sources, flag significant deviations

entries.name: discriminating-prediction-design
entries.description: SOP: 设计能区分竞争假设的关键预测和观察方案

entries.name: distribution-assignment
entries.description: Assign probability distributions to uncertain parameters based on available evidence and domain knowledge.

entries.name: divergence-detection
entries.description: Identifies agreement and disagreement patterns across multiple perspective evaluations. Maps consensus clusters and persistent divergence points.

entries.name: diversity-maximization
entries.description: Maximize portfolio diversity and coverage using MAP-Elites, Niche coverage, Maximum dispersion, and Anti-clustering methods.

entries.name: documentation-audit
entries.description: Assess documentation completeness against BetterBench/Datasheets standards

entries.name: domain-divergence
entries.description: Scan and select maximally diverse source domains. Ensures creative search covers genuinely unrelated fields with high transfer potential.

entries.name: domain-scanning
entries.description: Scan distant domains for transferable principles. Uses web-search and paper-overview to identify analogous solutions in unrelated fields.

entries.name: dominance-check
entries.description: Identify dominated and non-dominated alternatives in a score matrix using Pareto dominance.

entries.name: dominant-idea-escape
entries.description: Identify dominant paradigms constraining the field and use de Bono lateral thinking provocations to escape them.

entries.name: dominant-idea-identification
entries.description: Identify dominant paradigms and assumptions constraining thinking in a research field.

entries.name: duration-estimation
entries.description: Three-point PERT estimation for implementation activities

entries.name: dynamic-tracking
entries.description: Strategy for continuous rating updates using Elo, Glicko-2, TrueSkill 2, and Whole-History Rating for live ranking systems and A/B testing.

entries.name: eclipse-application
entries.description: SOP: 应用 ECLIPSE 框架结构化混合方法研究问题

entries.name: ecosystem-pattern
entries.description: Extract ecosystem-level organization patterns (symbiosis, emergence, resilience) as design templates for complex systems.

entries.name: ecosystem-pattern-extraction
entries.description: Extract ecosystem-level organization patterns (symbiosis, emergence, cycles, resilience).

entries.name: edge-case-generation
entries.description: Systematically generate boundary inputs — boundary values, adversarial constructions, distribution shifts, rare combinations, scale extremes.

entries.name: effect-size-extraction
entries.description: Systematically extract effect sizes and conditions from papers for meta-analytic synthesis

entries.name: effect-size-planning
entries.description: Determine effect size types and calculation methods for meta-analytic synthesis

entries.name: efficient-exploration
entries.description: Strategy for large-N sparse pairwise comparison using TrueSkill, active learning, and rank centrality to rank 100+ candidates from limited comparisons.

entries.name: egm-construction
entries.description: Build structured Evidence Gap Maps — define axes (intervention × outcome or method × domain), place gaps in cells, annotate with evidence density and quality.

entries.name: egregore
entries.description: Autonomous agent orchestrator for full development lifecycles with zero human input, session budget management, and crash recovery
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: emergence-detection
entries.description: Detect and validate emergent properties from combinations. Orchestrates emergent-property-identification → blend-elaboration.

entries.name: emergent-property-hunting
entries.description: Seek properties that emerge from combination (non-additive)

entries.name: emergent-property-identification
entries.description: Identify non-additive properties from combinations

entries.name: emulation-generation
entries.description: Generate technical solutions emulating biological strategies. Bridge from design principle to concrete implementation.

entries.name: enumeration-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all systematic enumeration outputs into a structured idea report with prioritized recommendations.

entries.name: environment-specification
entries.description: SOP: define complete experiment environment specification

entries.name: escape-technique
entries.description: Identify dominant thinking pattern and escape it via deliberate pattern-breaking.

entries.name: evaluation-filtering
entries.description: Multi-dimensional evaluation and tiered filtering of generated ideas. Orchestrates novelty assessment → feasibility check → ranking → selection.

entries.name: evaluation-protocol-comparison
entries.description: Compare implementation differences of same benchmark across papers

entries.name: evaporating-cloud
entries.description: Model conflicts as Goldratt's Evaporating Cloud — expose hidden assumptions behind opposing needs to dissolve the conflict.

entries.name: evidence-based-prioritization
entries.description: Strategy: 基于证据强度的 AHRQ PiCMe 评估——用文献证据质量驱动 gap 优先级

entries.name: evidence-grading
entries.description: Assess evidence quality using GRADE/SOE framework. Rates certainty level and identifies downgrade reasons.

entries.name: evidence-mapping
entries.description: Systematic evidence map construction — search, classify, locate gaps, visualize. Combines concept-matrix-construction, gap-keyword-extraction, evidence-grading, and egm-construction SOPs.

entries.name: evidence-network-construction
entries.description: Build evidence network graph for network meta-analysis — nodes, edges, geometry assessment

entries.name: evidence-scout
entries.description: Searches for external evidence supporting or opposing specific claims. Returns structured evidence with source assessment and relevance scoring.

entries.name: evidence-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize multi-source evidence into structured argumentation. Weaves findings from literature, web, and analysis into coherent evidence maps with explicit strength ratings.

entries.name: evidence-synthesis-planning
entries.description: Plan the statistical synthesis approach — model selection, heterogeneity strategy, and reporting

entries.name: evidence-tournament
entries.description: Tactic: Evidence gathering, cross-examination, and quality judgment. External evidence is collected, presented, challenged, and scored for relevance and reliability.

entries.name: evolution-mechanism-transfer
entries.description: Map evolution mechanisms to design operations. Translate selection, mutation, drift, radiation into design operators.

entries.name: evolution-strategy
entries.description: Use evolution mechanisms (selection, mutation, radiation) as design operators for generating and refining solution populations.

entries.name: excursion-departure
entries.description: Leave the problem entirely and explore an unrelated domain. Produces excursion domain discoveries for later force-fitting.

entries.name: excursion-method
entries.description: Full 8-stage Gordon-Prince excursion process. Deliberate departure from the problem into unrelated domains, then force-fit discoveries back.

entries.name: excursion-orchestration
entries.description: Orchestrate the excursion sequence — departure into unrelated domain, force-fit discoveries back to problem, launch springboard ideas.

entries.name: executing-specs
entries.description: Execute a Research Spec step by step, respecting context protocol, deviation limits, and backtrack rules. Supports multi-session recovery.

entries.name: execution-monitoring
entries.description: Monitor execution progress, detect anomalies, and report status

entries.name: execution-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize complete execution report from all results, tests, and reproducibility data

entries.name: experiment-config-generation
entries.description: SOP: generate executable experiment configuration files

entries.name: experiment-design
entries.description: Transform validated hypotheses into rigorous, executable experiment designs

entries.name: experiment-running
entries.description: Execute the plan by dispatching fresh subagents per task, monitoring status, and collecting results

entries.name: explanation-generation
entries.description: SOP: 为异常现象生成候选解释列表

entries.name: explore-resume
entries.description: Understand the user's background comprehensively — technical stack, project experience, research experience, publications, research directions. Allows user to express interest beyond their resume. Execute once only, never re-run.

entries.name: extract-data
entries.description: Structured data extraction from deep-read papers — produces comparison tables (method, dataset, metrics, results, limitations). Used by systematic-survey and deep-survey.

entries.name: extreme-value-generation
entries.description: Generate boundary and extreme test values for a given parameter dimension to stress-test claims.

entries.name: facet-bisociation
entries.description: Bridge two unrelated thinking matrices via Koestler bisociation. Identify independent frames of reference and force collision to produce creative insight.

entries.name: factor-enumeration
entries.description: List all key factors, conditions, and assumptions that support or enable the artifact's conclusion.

entries.name: factor-identification
entries.description: Identify independent, dependent, and control variables for an experiment

entries.name: factor-level-design
entries.description: Identify factors and their levels for a problem, then design an experiment matrix for systematic exploration.

entries.name: factor-removal
entries.description: Strategy: Systematic factor removal — remove factors one at a time and observe whether the conclusion remains stable, identifying which factors are load-bearing.

entries.name: factorial-ideation
entries.description: DOE thinking: identify factors, define levels, and explore combinations to systematically cover the design space.

entries.name: failure-anticipation
entries.description: Campaign: Forward-looking failure analysis combining pre-mortem rapid screening with systematic FMEA deep-dive. Core question: If this artifact fails, how will it fail? Methods: Klein Pre-Mortem 2007, AIAG-VDA FMEA 2019, IEC 60812.

entries.name: failure-chain-construction
entries.description: Build cause-mode-effect chains tracing upstream root causes and downstream cascading effects for each failure mode.

entries.name: failure-chain-tracing
entries.description: Tactic: Trace upstream causes and downstream effects of each failure mode. Builds multi-level cause-mode-effect chains for systemic understanding.

entries.name: failure-clustering
entries.description: Group observed failures by mechanism (not symptom), identify common triggers per cluster, estimate frequency and severity.

entries.name: failure-driven-generation
entries.description: Generate targeted solutions for each identified failure mode, ensuring every failure has at least one proposed mitigation.

entries.name: failure-mode-analysis
entries.description: Systematically catalog failure modes — generate edge cases, observe failures, cluster by mechanism, identify triggers and frequency.

entries.name: failure-mode-cataloging
entries.description: Systematic failure mode cataloging — generate boundary inputs, observe failures, cluster by mechanism, identify triggers, estimate frequency.

entries.name: failure-mode-extraction
entries.description: Extract structured failure mode list from raw scenarios or artifact analysis. Produces standardized failure mode records.

entries.name: failure-taxonomy
entries.description: Catalog all failure modes in a domain, classify them systematically, and generate targeted solutions for each failure type.

entries.name: false-gap-filtering
entries.description: Detect false gaps — search failures, already-solved gaps, and inherently unanswerable questions masquerading as research gaps.

entries.name: falsifiability-audit
entries.description: Tactic: 假设质量保证——检验可证伪性，修复不合格假设，完成操作化与边界条件规范

entries.name: falsifiability-check
entries.description: SOP: 检验假设是否满足可证伪性标准

entries.name: fantasy-analogy
entries.description: Wish-fulfillment thinking — ignore physical laws for ideal solution. Use unconstrained imagination to reveal what the problem truly needs.

entries.name: fantasy-wish
entries.description: Unconstrained wish-fulfillment ideation. Ignore all physical laws to imagine the ideal solution, then identify realization directions.

entries.name: feasibility-assessment
entries.description: Feasibility Assessment Campaign — evaluate whether selected candidates can actually be implemented using TRL, NASSS, Stage-Gate, TRIZ, TOC, and parametric estimation methods.

entries.name: feasibility-check
entries.description: Cross-reference the GoalTree against ActorProfile (capabilities), ObstacleReport (known barriers), and timeline (deadline feasibility). Identify infeasible paths and suggest OR alternatives.

entries.name: feasibility-constrained-formulation
entries.description: Strategy: 在资源约束下重塑研究问题 — pragmatic 调整保持核心价值

entries.name: feasibility-scoring
entries.description: SOP: 评估研究 gap 的可攻击性，识别瓶颈并输出可行性评分

entries.name: feasibility-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all assessments into a feasibility matrix, recommendation, and risk summary.

entries.name: feedback-distribution
entries.description: Create anonymized feedback report summarizing group judgment distribution for a given round.

entries.name: final-validation
entries.description: Self-review the North Star + ResearchBrief for completeness, consistency, and clarity before presenting to user. If issues found, return to specific tactic/SOP for targeted fix. If passes, present final output to user for confirmation.

entries.name: finding-aggregation
entries.description: Aggregate, deduplicate, and classify findings from multiple probes into a coherent vulnerability report.

entries.name: finer-criteria-check
entries.description: SOP: FINER 5 项标准逐项检验研究问题质量

entries.name: five-whys-drilling
entries.description: Iterative "Why?" questioning (5+ levels) to drill from surface phenomenon to actionable root cause. Each level verified against evidence.

entries.name: flip-point-detection
entries.description: Find the minimal change magnitude along a dimension that causes the conclusion to flip from true to false.

entries.name: force-fit
entries.description: Force-fit excursion discoveries back to the original problem. Deliberately create connections between unrelated findings and the challenge.

entries.name: forced-bridge-construction
entries.description: Force connections between unrelated technologies. Deliberately construct bridges where none naturally exist to discover novel integration possibilities.

entries.name: forced-connection
entries.description: Force connection between two unrelated concepts. Deliberately construct bridging paths where no natural connection exists.

entries.name: formulate-top-goal
entries.description: Express the user's chosen research direction as a formal goal statement in the format: 'Achieve [what], such that [effect], under [constraints]'. Confirm with user before proceeding to decomposition.

entries.name: fractionation
entries.description: Split concepts into smaller units and recombine them differently to produce novel structures.

entries.name: fragility-flagging
entries.description: Identify which specific assumption changes cause conclusion divergence. Rates fragility severity and plausibility of alternatives.

entries.name: fragility-measurement
entries.description: Compute a fragility index from flip-point distances and degradation scores, summarizing how robust the conclusion is.

entries.name: framework-guided-formulation
entries.description: Strategy: 选择 RQ 框架（PICO/SPIDER/SPICE/ECLIPSE）并系统应用

entries.name: framework-matching
entries.description: SOP: 根据研究类型匹配最适合的 RQ 框架

entries.name: framework-selection-and-application
entries.description: Tactic: 选择最适合的 RQ 框架并系统应用

entries.name: full-ranking
entries.description: Produce a complete ordering of all candidates using PROMETHEE I/II, ELECTRE III, or MAVT methods.

entries.name: function-analysis
entries.description: FMEA Step 3: Decompose artifact into function tree — identify what each component is supposed to do before analyzing how it can fail.

entries.name: function-combination
entries.description: TRIZ function analysis: function-level recombination and redistribution

entries.name: function-model-construction
entries.description: Build substance-field functional model of a system, annotating useful, harmful, insufficient, and excessive interactions.

entries.name: function-redistribution
entries.description: Redistribute functions across different components

entries.name: function-trimming
entries.description: Remove components while preserving function via TRIZ trimming methodology. Simplify systems by redistributing functions.

entries.name: functional-analogy
entries.description: Map technical functions to biological functions, find organisms solving equivalent problems. Deep functional matching across domains.

entries.name: functional-model-biology
entries.description: Build biological system functional model. Map energy, matter, and information flows.

entries.name: future-reality-projection
entries.description: Project solution effects using Future Reality Tree logic

entries.name: futures-calibration
entries.description: Aggregate probability judgments across perspectives using Real-Time Delphi or prediction market mechanisms.

entries.name: gap-analysis
entries.description: Gap Analysis Campaign — identify, classify, validate, and prioritize research gaps via systematic evidence mapping. 5 strategies (gap-identification, gap-classification, gap-validation, gap-prioritization, gap-synthesis), 3 tactics, 12 subagent SOPs.

entries.name: gap-classification
entries.description: Classify identified gaps using Miles 7-type taxonomy and AHRQ 4-reason framework. Determines gap type (theoretical, methodological, empirical, etc.) and root cause of gap existence.

entries.name: gap-driven-generation
entries.description: Generate solutions targeting specific coverage gaps — detect gaps, generate failure-driven solutions, and design factor-level experiments.

entries.name: gap-identification
entries.description: Identify what the literature has NOT addressed — missing methods, untested combinations, unexplored applications, contradictions without resolution. Used by all strategies.

entries.name: gap-keyword-extraction
entries.description: Extract gap-indicating sentences and phrases from papers/reviews. Identifies linguistic markers of research gaps (e.g., "remains unclear", "has not been explored", "limited understanding").

entries.name: gap-normalization
entries.description: SOP: 统一不同来源的 gap 格式为标准 GapRecord

entries.name: gap-pairwise-judgment
entries.description: SOP: 对两个 gap 进行逐标准相对优先级判断，输出偏好结果

entries.name: gap-prioritization
entries.description: Score and rank validated gaps on importance, feasibility, novelty, and urgency. Multi-criteria decision analysis with stakeholder confirmation.

entries.name: gap-synthesis
entries.description: Compile all gap analysis intermediate products into a coherent final report with executive summary, detailed findings, and research agenda.

entries.name: gap-synthesis-strategy
entries.description: Compile all gap analysis products into a coherent final report with evidence gap maps, research agenda, and concept matrices.

entries.name: gap-typology-classification
entries.description: Classify gaps using Miles 7-type taxonomy (theoretical, methodological, empirical, population, practical, knowledge void, evidence gap).

entries.name: gap-validation
entries.description: Validate gap authenticity via cross-database verification, temporal sensitivity testing, and false-gap filtering. Ensures gaps are genuine absences, not search artifacts.

entries.name: gate-criteria-definition
entries.description: Define gate criteria and pass thresholds for a specific stage in the Stage-Gate process.

entries.name: gate-judgment
entries.description: Evaluate a candidate against gate criteria and render GO/KILL/RECYCLE verdict with evidence.

entries.name: gauntlet
entries.description: Codebase learning through knowledge extraction, code knowledge graph, challenges, and spaced repetition. Prevents knowledge atrophy for experienced developers and accelerates onboarding for new ones.
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: general-morphological-analysis
entries.description: Ritchey GMA: complete iterative morphological process

entries.name: generate-candidate-fields
entries.description: Propose 3-8 candidate research fields based on the full ActorProfile. When user wants to explore beyond their current stack, use other ActorProfile signals (intentionality, boundary) to determine exploration space. Free exploration within the boundary.

entries.name: generate-research-brief
entries.description: Aggregate all accumulated context from the crystallization process into a structured ResearchBrief document. This is the final output artifact alongside the North Star — a comprehensive requirement context document for downstream research strategies.

entries.name: generic-space-extraction
entries.description: Extract shared abstract structure from two input spaces

entries.name: goal-decomposition
entries.description: Structure the user's chosen direction into a formal goal tree using KAOS-style AND/OR decomposition. Validate feasibility against ActorProfile and ObstacleReport. Use after obstacle-analysis confirms the direction is viable.

entries.name: governing-variable-surfacing
entries.description: Apply Argyris framework to identify governing variables — the unstated rules driving behavior in a research field.

entries.name: green-hat-session
entries.description: Structured creative thinking in Six Hats Green Hat mode — pure creative output with judgment suspended.

entries.name: groupthink-mitigation
entries.description: Strategy: 10th Man Rule and Liberating Structures — institutionalized dissent to prevent premature consensus and expose suppressed objections.

entries.name: headroom-estimation
entries.description: Estimate theoretical/practical ceiling vs current SOTA gap

entries.name: herald
entries.description: Standalone notification system for Claude Code plugins. Provides GitHub issue alerts and webhook support (Slack, Discord, generic).
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: heterogeneity-source-analysis
entries.description: Identify and classify sources of between-study heterogeneity (clinical, methodological, statistical)

entries.name: hmw-formulation
entries.description: Generate "How Might We" questions at different scope levels (narrow, medium, broad). Ensures each is actionable without being prescriptive.

entries.name: hookify
entries.description: Create custom behavioral rules through markdown configuration files - prevent unwanted behaviors with pattern matching
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: hot-start
entries.description: Minimal crystallization strategy for users who already have a specific research topic or problem (e.g., "I want to improve CoT faithfulness in LLMs") and need structuring into a formal North Star. Heavily simplifies or skips exploration tactics, focusing on obstacle analysis, goal decomposition, and synthesis. Use when the user's first message reveals a specific, actionable research direction.

entries.name: hypothesis-comparison-matrix
entries.description: SOP: 构建竞争假设的多维度对比矩阵

entries.name: hypothesis-formulation
entries.description: Campaign: 将 insight 和 gap 转化为结构化的可测试假设

entries.name: hypothesis-operationalization
entries.description: Strategy: 将 working hypothesis 精确化为可测试形式

entries.name: hypothesis-synthesis
entries.description: SOP: 综合所有中间产物，产出最终结构化假设集

entries.name: idea-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize diverse ideas into coherent solution concepts. Combines fragments from multiple ideation passes into structured, actionable ideas with clear mechanism descriptions.

entries.name: identify-obstacles
entries.description: Enumerate barriers to pursuing the chosen research direction — knowledge barriers, resource barriers, capability barriers, competition barriers. May optionally use search tools to discover obstacles the user hasn't mentioned.

entries.name: imbue
entries.description: Intelligent workflow methodologies: analysis, evidence gathering, structured output, and research-enriched feature review with RICE/WSJF/Kano scoring
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: impact-scoring
entries.description: SOP: 评估研究 gap 的潜在影响力，识别受益方并输出影响力评分

entries.name: implementation-planning
entries.description: Plan execution path, produce executable plan, dispatch subagents, collect and analyze results

entries.name: implementer-dispatch
entries.description: Dispatch execution subagent — select model by complexity, construct prompt with full task context

entries.name: importance-scoring
entries.description: SOP: 评估研究 gap 的学术与实践重要性，输出 1-5 分及依据

entries.name: inclusion-criteria-design
entries.description: Define inclusion/exclusion criteria for systematic study selection in meta-analysis

entries.name: inconsistency-localization
entries.description: Identify which specific comparison pairs are most responsible for preference cycles and inconsistencies.

entries.name: inductive-hypothesis-generation
entries.description: Strategy: 从数据/观察归纳提炼假设

entries.name: input-space-construction
entries.description: Build input spaces for two source concepts

entries.name: insight
entries.description: Insight Campaign — deep root-cause analysis of why research gaps persist. 5 strategies (root-cause-drilling, stakeholder-mapping, tension-mining, question-reformulation, assumption-audit), 4 tactics, 13 subagent SOPs.

entries.name: interaction-detection
entries.description: Detect and characterize significant parameter interactions from Sobol decomposition results.

entries.name: intermediate-objective-design
entries.description: Design intermediate objectives to overcome each identified obstacle

entries.name: intersection-evaluation
entries.description: Evaluate exploration status of each cell in a method×problem matrix, annotating as explored, partial, or unexplored.

entries.name: inversion-extraction
entries.description: Extract constructive insights from worst solutions. Transform failure analysis into innovation directions.

entries.name: inversion-protocol
entries.description: Reverse statements → extract insights → build constructive alternatives. Systematic inversion pipeline from negation to innovation.

entries.name: ishikawa-decomposition
entries.description: Decompose problems into 6M categories (Methodology, Data, Theory, Measurement, Researchers, Environment) via fishbone diagram analysis.

entries.name: iterative-convergence-round
entries.description: Execute one full Delphi round — collect judgments, distribute anonymous feedback, measure consensus, decide whether to continue.

entries.name: jtbd-mapping
entries.description: Map stakeholder Jobs-to-be-Done — functional, emotional, and social jobs for each affected party. Identifies unserved jobs as opportunity signals.

entries.name: judge-verdict
entries.description: Render an impartial verdict on advocate case vs critic attacks with explicit reasoning.

entries.name: judgment-collection
entries.description: Collect independent judgments from all perspectives on a given question.

entries.name: key-assumptions-check
entries.description: Military ACT: systematically enumerate all assumptions, classify by type, and evaluate evidence strength supporting each.

entries.name: lakatos-heuristics
entries.description: Proofs and Refutations method: generate counterexamples, attempt monster-barring, incorporate surviving counterexamples as lemma refinements.

entries.name: landscape-reconnaissance
entries.description: Broad, shallow exploration of candidate research fields. Understand what's out there before narrowing. Use when the user needs to discover which fields are available to them — especially in cold-start and warm-start scenarios.

entries.name: landscape-synthesis
entries.description: Evaluate each candidate research field on maturity, competition, entry barrier, and publication opportunity. Synthesizes broad-web-search results into a structured FieldPanorama. Must consider both niche approaches AND direct frontal competition in hot fields.

entries.name: lateral-escape
entries.description: de Bono lateral escape sequence — identify dominant idea, generate provocations (escape/reversal/exaggeration/distortion), follow consequences to extract new framings. Breaks paradigm lock-in.

entries.name: lateral-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all lateral thinking intermediate outputs into a structured idea report.

entries.name: lateral-thinking
entries.description: Lateral Thinking Campaign — escape logical thinking tracks via PO/movement, random entry, concept fan, challenge, and six hats (de Bono)

entries.name: leaderboard-dynamics-analysis
entries.description: Analyze leaderboard score distributions, compression, selective reporting

entries.name: leaderboard-harvesting
entries.description: Systematically collect performance data from platforms and papers

entries.name: legal-status-assessment
entries.description: Determine patent legal status — active, expired, pending, lapsed, or revoked

entries.name: level-specification
entries.description: Determine appropriate levels for each experimental factor

entries.name: leyline
entries.description: Infrastructure and pipeline building blocks for Claude Code plugins. Like ancient ley lines connecting sacred sites, leyline provides the foundational patterns that connect and power plugin ecosystems.
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: life-principles-application
entries.description: Apply life's principles as design constraints. Orchestrates ecosystem-pattern-extraction → evolution-mechanism-transfer → abstraction-to-design.

entries.name: Literature Overview
entries.description: Quick landscape scan — discover papers on a topic without full-text reading

entries.name: Literature Research
entries.description: Deep literature research — raw full text reading and targeted PDF queries for rigorous analysis

entries.name: Literature Search
entries.description: Medium-depth literature search — read AI-summarized reports for every paper analyzed

entries.name: literature-survey
entries.description: Autonomous Literature Survey Campaign — 5 research paradigms (scoping, systematic, deep, narrative, snowball) with quantitative budget enforcement. Selects and executes the right survey paradigm based on research intent.

entries.name: load-bearing-identification
entries.description: Identify which factors are "load-bearing walls" — factors whose removal would collapse the conclusion.

entries.name: matrix-construction
entries.description: Build n-dimensional morphological matrix

entries.name: maturation-pathway-design
entries.description: Design path to readiness using Stage-Gate, Technology Roadmapping, and milestone planning methods.

entries.name: maturity-diagnosis
entries.description: Assess current readiness of candidates using TRL 9-level, NASSS 7-dimension, and Innovation Readiness Level frameworks.

entries.name: mechanism-extraction
entries.description: SOP: 从理论中提取因果机制链

entries.name: memory-palace
entries.description: Spatial knowledge organization using memory palace techniques - build, navigate, and maintain virtual memory structures for enhanced recall and information management. Includes PR Review Room for capturing review knowledge.
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: meta-analysis
entries.description: Cross-Study Statistical Synthesis Campaign — 5 strategies for systematic collection and methodological planning of multi-study evidence synthesis. Covers pairwise, network, cumulative meta-analysis, heterogeneity investigation, and bias detection. Stops at protocol design (no computation).

entries.name: meta-analysis-synthesis
entries.description: Produce final meta-analysis protocol document assembling all planning outputs into PRISMA-compliant protocol

entries.name: method-discovery
entries.description: Identify all relevant methods via literature, leaderboards, citation chains

entries.name: method-inventory
entries.description: Comprehensively identify all relevant methods for a task — 50 methods, 60 web searches budget

entries.name: method-problem-crossing
entries.description: Build method×problem cross-reference matrix showing which methods have been applied to which problems.

entries.name: method-problem-matrix
entries.description: Cross method×problem matrix, find unexplored intersections where known methods have not been applied to known problems.

entries.name: method-sensitivity-report
entries.description: Analyze how the choice of MCDA method affects final rankings and identify method-sensitive alternatives.

entries.name: metric-decomposition
entries.description: Decompose composite metrics into constituent signals, analyze polarity and ceiling effects

entries.name: metric-specification
entries.description: Define experiment metrics and significance standards

entries.name: minimal-change-search
entries.description: Tactic: Generate candidate changes, detect flip-points where conclusion reverses, measure fragility as distance to nearest flip.

entries.name: minister
entries.description: Project management plugin that aligns initiatives with GitHub data - turns repositories, issues, and projects into status dashboards
entries.author: Alex Thola

entries.name: mitigation-design
entries.description: Strategy: Design prevention, detection, and response measures for high-priority failure modes. Produces actionable countermeasures validated via re-scoring.

entries.name: mitigation-design-sop
entries.description: Design prevention, detection, and response measures for high-priority failure modes. Produces actionable countermeasure specifications.

entries.name: mitigation-proposal
entries.description: Proposes concrete mitigation strategies for identified weaknesses. Generates prevention, detection, and response measures with feasibility assessment.

entries.name: mitigation-validation
entries.description: Tactic: Run mini-FMEA on proposed mitigations to verify they do not introduce new failure modes. Prevents mitigation-induced risks.

entries.name: monster-barring-attempt
entries.description: Attempt to exclude a counterexample as illegitimate by tightening definitions or preconditions (Lakatos monster-barring).

entries.name: monte-carlo-sampling
entries.description: Design and execute Monte Carlo sampling strategy for uncertainty propagation through a model.

entries.name: morphological-exploration
entries.description: Morphological Exploration Campaign — systematic dimension-combination enumeration to discover unexplored solution spaces via Zwicky box, CCA, and GMA

entries.name: morphological-scenario
entries.description: What are all possible combinations? — Zwicky Box construction with CCA consistency filtering for systematic scenario enumeration

entries.name: morphological-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all morphological exploration outputs

entries.name: morris-screening
entries.description: Morris method screening — compute elementary effects to quickly identify important vs unimportant parameters.

entries.name: movement-extraction
entries.description: Extract constructive directions from provocations via 4 movement types (moment-to-moment, principle, focus difference, positive aspects).

entries.name: movement-operation
entries.description: Extract constructive directions from PO provocations using 4 movement types (moment-to-moment, principle, focus difference, positive aspects).

entries.name: multi-criteria-ranking
entries.description: Strategy: 多维度加权评分排序——将 gap 分解为独立子问题后重组为优先级列表

entries.name: multi-criteria-scoring
entries.description: Score gaps on multiple dimensions (importance, feasibility, novelty, urgency, impact) using weighted multi-criteria decision analysis.

entries.name: multi-dimensional-readiness-scan
entries.description: Assess readiness across multiple dimensions, synthesize into radar visualization, and identify bottleneck dimensions.

entries.name: multi-judge-aggregation
entries.description: Collect independent rankings from multiple judges, aggregate using social choice methods, and identify disagreement hotspots.

entries.name: multi-level-bisociation
entries.description: Simultaneous concept collision at multiple abstraction levels

entries.name: multi-method-triangulation
entries.description: Apply 2-3 MCDA methods to the same candidates, compare rankings, and identify method-sensitive options.

entries.name: multi-model-convergence
entries.description: Wimsatt-style multi-method cross-validation — enumerate assumptions, generate alternative models, compare results, flag divergences.

entries.name: multi-perspective-attack
entries.description: Assign distinct perspectives to attack a decision from multiple angles, then synthesize findings into a unified assessment.

entries.name: multi-perspective-panel
entries.description: Strategy: Multi-stakeholder review panel — diverse expert perspectives evaluate artifact simultaneously, then synthesize through structured deliberation.

entries.name: multi-perspective-reframing
entries.description: Apply CATWOE from multiple stakeholder viewpoints and reframing matrix to reveal aspects invisible from the dominant perspective.

entries.name: multi-stakeholder-simulation
entries.description: Simulate multiple stakeholder perspectives evaluating a research gap, method, or proposal. Identifies blind spots from single-perspective analysis.

entries.name: multi-worldview-comparison
entries.description: Multi-worldview comparison — CATWOE from multiple perspectives, reframing matrix across professional lenses, identify overlooked framings. Reveals what single-perspective analysis misses.

entries.name: multiagent-debate
entries.description: Campaign: Multi-agent structured debate for adversarial validation. Core question: Can this artifact survive structured adversarial debate? Methods: Irving AI Safety via Debate, Du Society of Mind, Liang MAD, Toulmin Argumentation, D3 framework.

entries.name: narrative-framing
entries.description: Theory-driven reading tactic — define a theoretical framework first, then guide reading to fill it with evidence. Five stages (theme identification, argument construction, evidence collection, counter-evidence, synthesis). The most intellectually demanding tactic.

entries.name: narrative-review
entries.description: Theory-driven literature review for building arguments and frameworks. Flexible, subjective, and narrative-focused — selects evidence strategically to support a thesis. High web-research budget for blogs, opinion pieces, and industry perspectives. Use when the user is writing a position paper, survey introduction, or constructing a coherent narrative around a research theme.

entries.name: narrative-scenario
entries.description: What is the story of each future? — Shell method narrative construction for rich qualitative scenario understanding

entries.name: necessity-evaluation
entries.description: Evaluate the probability of necessity (PN) for a causal factor — would the conclusion fail if this factor were absent?

entries.name: necessity-sufficiency
entries.description: Strategy: Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS/PS) — systematically evaluate whether each factor is necessary, sufficient, both, or neither for the conclusion.

entries.name: negation-definition
entries.description: Define strongest plausible alternatives (negations) for each assumption to enable perturbation analysis.

entries.name: niche-coverage-analysis
entries.description: Define niches within the solution space, map candidates to niches, score coverage completeness, and identify gaps requiring attention.

entries.name: niche-definition
entries.description: Define niches and capability areas that a portfolio should cover based on domain structure and objectives.

entries.name: niche-mapping
entries.description: Map each candidate to the niches it covers, indicating strength of coverage for each assignment.

entries.name: non-compensatory-screening
entries.description: Eliminate non-qualifying candidates using conjunctive rules, dominance filtering, lexicographic ordering, or veto thresholds.

entries.name: normalization
entries.description: Normalize a score matrix using a specified method to make scores comparable across criteria.

entries.name: north-star-crystallization
entries.description: Goal-Driven Requirement Refinement Engine for Research. Crystallize a user's fuzzy research intent into a North Star statement and structured ResearchBrief through adaptive dialogue and on-demand investigation.

entries.name: north-star-synthesis
entries.description: Converge all accumulated context into a crystallized North Star statement and structured ResearchBrief. Performs self-review before presenting to user. Use as the final tactic in any start mode — this is where everything comes together.

entries.name: novelty-scoring
entries.description: SOP: 评估研究 gap 的新颖性潜力，识别差异化方向并输出评分

entries.name: novice-perspective
entries.description: Novice perspective — question the 'obvious' by adopting deliberate ignorance to reveal hidden complexity.

entries.name: objective-definition
entries.description: Define optimization objectives, constraints, and trade-off preferences from context and candidate information.

entries.name: obstacle-analysis
entries.description: Identify what blocks the user from pursuing their chosen direction, assess severity, propose mitigations with search-validated evidence, and get user acceptance. Use after direction-narrowing has identified a specific direction.

entries.name: obstacle-identification
entries.description: TOC Prerequisite Tree — list obstacles preventing direct achievement of the objective

entries.name: occurrence-scoring
entries.description: Rate failure mode occurrence probability 1-10. Estimates how likely each failure mode is to manifest during research execution.

entries.name: operationalization
entries.description: SOP: 将抽象概念操作化为可测量的指标和方法

entries.name: optimization-run
entries.description: Execute multi-objective optimization on candidates to produce a Pareto front of non-dominated solutions.

entries.name: oracle
entries.description: ONNX Runtime inference daemon for ML-enhanced plugin capabilities. Provides local model inference over HTTP with explicit opt-in activation.

entries.name: organism-discovery
entries.description: Find organisms solving similar problems. Search across kingdoms for biological champions.

entries.name: pair-selector
entries.description: Select the next comparison pairs that maximize information gain given current ratings and comparison history.

entries.name: pairwise-comparison
entries.description: Tactic: 通过相对比较而非绝对评分对 gaps 进行排序，适用于难以量化的场景

entries.name: pairwise-ranking
entries.description: Pairwise Ranking Campaign — produce global rankings through pairwise comparisons and voting aggregation using Bradley-Terry, Elo, TrueSkill, Condorcet, Borda, Schulze methods.

entries.name: paper-overview
entries.description: Abstract-level paper scanning for broad coverage. Import of literature-engine/literature-overview skill. Abstract-level only — no methodology conclusions from abstracts.

entries.name: paper-research
entries.description: Full-depth paper reading with raw text extraction. Import of literature-engine/literature-research skill. Must read fullText (true) — equations, hyperparameters, specific claims extracted.

entries.name: paper-search
entries.description: AI-summarized paper reading for intermediate depth. Import of literature-engine/literature-search skill. Must call get_paper_content for every analyzed paper.

entries.name: parameter-enumeration
entries.description: Enumerate possible values for each uncertainty driver using MECE principles

entries.name: parameter-identification
entries.description: Identify the key parameters/dimensions of a problem space. Produces a structured parameter list with value ranges for morphological analysis.

entries.name: parameter-screening
entries.description: Quick Morris method screening to identify which parameters have large effects and which can be safely ignored.

entries.name: parameter-space-construction
entries.description: Orchestrates driver identification and parameter enumeration to build the complete morphological field

entries.name: parameter-space-mapping
entries.description: Identify all parameter dimensions along which a claim's validity might vary.

entries.name: parameter-variation
entries.description: Systematic one-factor-at-a-time parameter sweep

entries.name: pareto-frontier-construction
entries.description: Build the Pareto frontier from multi-objective optimization, visualize trade-offs, and select a portfolio from non-dominated solutions.

entries.name: pareto-visualization
entries.description: Create visual representation of the Pareto frontier showing trade-offs between objectives with narrative explanation.

entries.name: parseltongue
entries.description: Modern Python development suite - testing, performance optimization, async patterns, and packaging

entries.name: patent-categorization
entries.description: Classify patents by tech subdomain, application scenario, and value chain position

entries.name: patent-family-tracing
entries.description: Forward/backward patent citation and priority tracing until saturation

entries.name: patent-mining
entries.description: Systematic Patent Analysis Campaign — 5 strategies for patent landscape analysis, prior art search, white space identification, competitive intelligence, and claim analysis. Produces structured patent intelligence reports.

entries.name: patent-query-formulation
entries.description: Construct keyword + IPC/CPC + assignee combination search strategies for patent databases

entries.name: patent-synthesis
entries.description: Produce final structured patent intelligence report from all analysis results

entries.name: path-generation
entries.description: Generate combination paths through consistent space

entries.name: pensive
entries.description: Reflective code review toolkit with structured analysis, blast radius analysis, domain expertise, and intelligent review orchestration

entries.name: performance-extraction
entries.description: Systematically extract performance data and conditions from papers — 30 methods, 150 data points, 40 web searches budget

entries.name: performance-table-assembly
entries.description: Assemble unified comparison table with confidence interval annotations

entries.name: persona-construction
entries.description: Build a detailed adversarial persona with background, motivation, expertise, blind spots, and preferred attack patterns.

entries.name: personal-analogy
entries.description: Empathic identification — become the system/component. First-person embodiment to discover hidden constraints and opportunities.

entries.name: personal-identification
entries.description: First-person empathic identification with a system or component. Produces experience description and design insights from embodiment.

entries.name: perspective-assignment
entries.description: Define distinct stakeholder or analytical perspectives with their values, concerns, and evaluation criteria.

entries.name: perspective-attack
entries.description: Attack a decision from a specific assigned perspective, producing rated arguments and constructive alternatives.

entries.name: perspective-critic
entries.description: Evaluates artifact from a specific assigned perspective. Produces assessment grounded in that viewpoint's values, priorities, and expertise.

entries.name: perspective-forcing
entries.description: Perspective Forcing Campaign — discover hidden solutions by systematically switching viewpoints via roles, six hats, temporal projection, and constraint injection

entries.name: perspective-rotation
entries.description: Rotate through reviewer/practitioner/theorist/time-machine/novice perspectives systematically. Ensures comprehensive viewpoint coverage.

entries.name: perspective-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all perspective outputs into a structured multi-perspective idea report.

entries.description: Computer use toolkit for driving desktop environments through Claude's vision and action API with screenshot capture, mouse/keyboard control, and an autonomous agent loop

entries.name: plan-formatting
entries.description: Format task plan as bite-sized executable tasks following superpowers:writing-plans conventions

entries.description: SOP: 对候选解释按合理性进行多维度加权排序

entries.name: po-provocation

entries.description: Map unresolvable tensions as Johnson polarities — 4 quadrants (positive/negative of each pole), early warnings, action steps for managing rather than solving.

entries.description: Evaluate a specific portfolio's performance metrics and vulnerabilities under a given scenario.

entries.name: portfolio-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize all per-scenario evaluations into a final portfolio recommendation with robustness score and actionable guidance.

entries.name: practitioner-hat
entries.description: Engineer perspective — assess buildability, cost, timeline, and integration challenges.

entries.name: prerequisite-planning
entries.description: Identify obstacles blocking direct achievement and design intermediate objectives to overcome each

entries.name: present-and-ask

entries.name: prioritization-scoring

entries.name: priority-sensitivity-testing
entries.description: Tactic: 扰动评分权重，检验 gap 排序对权重选择的稳健性

entries.name: priority-synthesis
entries.description: SOP: 综合所有评分数据产出最终 gap 优先级列表及攻击路径建议

entries.name: prisma-flowchart
entries.description: Generate PRISMA-compliant flow data documenting the screening funnel — counts at each stage (identification, screening, eligibility, inclusion) with exclusion reasons. Used by systematic-survey via prisma-screening tactic.

entries.name: probe-execution
entries.description: Execute a single attack probe against an artifact, record the result with evidence and severity classification.

entries.name: problem-biologization
entries.description: Restate technical problem as biological question. Translate engineering challenges into nature's language.

entries.name: process-fmea
entries.description: Strategy: Research execution process FMEA — analyzes how the research process itself can fail during execution, distinct from design-level failures.

entries.name: progress-curve-construction
entries.description: Build performance-over-time progress curves with inflection detection

entries.name: progress-curve-fitting
entries.description: Construct performance-over-time visualization data

entries.name: progress-quantification
entries.description: Track performance progress over time, quantify remaining headroom — 30 methods, 100 data points, 40 web searches budget

entries.name: propose-mitigations
entries.description: Propose concrete mitigation strategies for severe obstacles. MUST use search tools to validate that proposed mitigations are realistic — no armchair theorizing. Each mitigation must have evidence of feasibility.

entries.name: prospective-hindsight
entries.description: Strategy: Klein pre-mortem — assume the artifact has failed, then retrospect plausible causes. Generates rapid failure scenario catalog.

entries.name: protocol-element-extraction
entries.description: Extract evaluation protocol parameters from papers

entries.name: protocol-forensics
entries.description: Analyze evaluation protocol differences across papers for same benchmark — 5 benchmarks, 60 papers, 30 web searches

entries.description: PO + Movement: generate provocations then extract useful directions (4 movement types)

entries.description: Generate de Bono lateral thinking provocations to challenge dominant ideas using escape, reversal, exaggeration, and distortion.

entries.name: publication-bias-assessment
entries.description: Plan funnel plots, Egger's test, trim-and-fill, p-curve, and selection model analyses for publication bias

entries.name: quality-assessment

entries.name: quality-assessment-protocol
entries.description: Methodological quality and bias risk assessment of included studies using validated tools

entries.name: quality-gate-check
entries.description: Shared SOP: 通用质量门检查（格式完整性、逻辑一致性）

entries.name: quality-scoring
entries.description: Multi-dimensional patent quality assessment — forward citations, family size, claim count, geographic breadth

entries.name: question-refinement-loop
entries.description: Tactic: 迭代精化研究问题直到通过 FINER 5 项标准

entries.name: question-reformulation
entries.description: Reframe research questions using abstraction laddering, HMW formulation, and Socratic probing. Find the most productive level and framing for investigation.

entries.name: question-synthesis
entries.description: SOP: 综合所有中间产物产出最终研究问题集

entries.name: radar-synthesis
entries.description: Synthesize multiple dimension scores into radar chart data and compute overall readiness.

entries.name: random-entry
entries.description: Random word/concept as thinking entry point (de Bono Random Entry)

entries.name: random-paper-entry
entries.description: Select random paper facet as creative stimulus. Uses genuine randomness in paper selection to break domain fixation.

entries.name: random-stimulus-entry
entries.description: Random word/paper/concept as thinking entry point. Use genuine randomness to escape fixation and open unexpected solution paths.

entries.name: random-word-stimulus
entries.description: Use random word/concept injection as creative stimulus. Selects random concepts and forces connection to the problem space, generating unexpected solution paths.

entries.name: rank-comparison
entries.description: Compare multiple ranking results to assess agreement and identify divergent items.

entries.name: ranking-synthesis
entries.description: Produce the final ranking artifact from converged ratings and consistency report.

entries.name: rapid-triage
entries.description: Strategy: 快速粗筛——两轮过滤将大量 gaps 压缩为可精排的候选集

entries.name: rating-update
entries.description: Incorporate a new judgment into the rating model and return updated ratings for all candidates.

entries.name: re-derivation

entries.name: re-scoring

entries.name: recombination-architecture
entries.description: Reassemble decomposed fragments into novel structures through systematic recombination of components.

entries.name: recombination-generation
entries.description: Reassemble decomposed system fragments into novel structural arrangements that create emergent value.

entries.name: red-teaming

entries.name: reformulation-synthesis
entries.description: Compile all problem reformulation analyses into a coherent report with a recommended new problem definition.

entries.name: reframing-matrix
entries.description: Reframe the problem from 4 professional perspectives to reveal what each discipline would focus on.

entries.name: relationship-specification
entries.description: SOP: 指定变量间关系的方向与形式

entries.name: removability-assessment
entries.description: Assess how removable a constraint is with effort estimate and dependency analysis.

entries.name: removal-path
entries.description: Design concrete removal steps for a constraint with timeline and resource needs.

entries.name: reproducibility-checklist-audit
entries.description: Assess paper completeness against ML Reproducibility Checklist

entries.name: reproducibility-protocol
entries.description: Ensure experiment reproducibility through systematic environment and seed control

entries.name: reproducibility-verification
entries.description: Verify result reproducibility via re-runs with different seeds and ICC comparison

entries.description: Campaign: 将假设细化为精确的、框架化的研究问题

entries.description: Estimate resources, budget, and timeline using parametric, analogous, and three-point (PERT) estimation methods.

entries.name: resource-quantification
entries.description: Quantify resource demand vs supply vs gap for each resource category

entries.description: Statistically analyze collected results, verify reproducibility, and synthesize findings

entries.name: result-collection
entries.description: Collect experiment outputs — metrics, logs, artifacts — into structured result set

entries.name: result-validation-loop
entries.description: Validate results through statistical testing, ROPE judgment, reproducibility re-runs, and final synthesis

Trigger whenever the user mentions SOLID principles for robots, modular robotics software, clean architecture for robots, dependency injection in robotics, interface design for hardware, real-time design constraints, error handling strategies for robots, configuration management, separation of concerns in perception-planning- control, composability of robot behaviors, or any discussion of software craftsmanship in a robotics context. Also trigger for code reviews of robotics code, refactoring robot software, or designing APIs for robotics libraries.

entries.name: robotics-testing
entries.description: Testing strategies, patterns, and tools for robotics software. Use this skill when writing unit tests, integration tests, simulation tests, or hardware-in-the-loop tests for robot systems. Trigger whenever the user mentions testing ROS nodes, pytest with ROS, launch_testing, simulation testing, CI/CD for robotics, test fixtures for sensors, mock hardware, deterministic replay, regression testing for robot behaviors, or validating perception/planning/control pipelines. Also covers property-based testing for kinematics, fuzz testing for message handlers, and golden-file testing for trajectories.

entries.name: ros1-development
entries.description: Best practices, design patterns, and common pitfalls for ROS1 (Robot Operating System 1) development. Use this skill when building ROS1 nodes, packages, launch files, or debugging ROS1 systems. Trigger whenever the user mentions ROS1, catkin, rospy, roscpp, roslaunch, roscore, rostopic, tf, actionlib, message types, services, or any ROS1-era robotics middleware. entries.name: ros2-development
entries.description: Comprehensive best practices, design patterns, and common pitfalls for ROS2 (Robot Operating System 2) development. Use this skill when building ROS2 nodes, packages, launch files, components, or debugging ROS2 systems. Trigger whenever the user mentions ROS2, colcon, rclpy, rclcpp, DDS, QoS, lifecycle nodes, managed nodes, ROS2 launch, ROS2 parameters, ROS2 actions, nav2, MoveIt2, micro-ROS, or any ROS2-era robotics middleware. Also trigger for ROS2 workspace setup, DDS tuning, intra-process communication, ROS2 security, or deploying ROS2 in production. Also trigger for colcon build issues, ament_cmake, ament_python, CMakeLists.txt for ROS2, package.xml dependencies, rosdep, workspace overlays, custom message generation, or ROS2 build troubleshooting. Covers Humble, Iron, Jazzy, and Rolling distributions.

entries.name: ros2-web-integration
entries.description: Patterns and best practices for integrating ROS2 systems with web technologies including REST APIs, WebSocket bridges, and browser-based robot interfaces. Use this skill when building web dashboards for robots, streaming camera feeds to browsers, exposing ROS2 services as REST endpoints, or implementing bidirectional WebSocket communication between web UIs and ROS2 nodes. Trigger whenever the user mentions rosbridge, rosbridge_suite, roslibjs, FastAPI with ROS2, Flask with rclpy, WebSocket for robot telemetry, MJPEG streaming, WebRTC for robots, REST API wrapping ROS2 services, web-based robot control, browser robot interface, robot dashboard, CORS configuration for robots, or any web-to-ROS2 bridge pattern. Also trigger for authentication on robot web interfaces, rate limiting sensor streams, video streaming from robot cameras to browsers, or running async web frameworks alongside the ROS2 executor. Covers rosbridge_suite, FastAPI, Flask, WebSocket, and WebRTC approaches.

entries.name: happyhorse-prompter
entries.description: 生成符合 HappyHorse 1.0 严格规则的紧凑提示词（30-55 词），主体先行 + 明确镜头技术 + 音频激活路径（with X audible / speaking English at natural pace）。可选加入"8s 时序节拍"结构。用于"用 HappyHorse 生成视频"、"做个 3-15 秒短片"、"要原生带音频的视频"、"ASMR 视频提示词"等触发场景。

entries.name: kling-prompter
entries.description: 生成符合 Kling 3.0（可灵 3.0，快手）规则的视频提示词。三种写法自适应：4 部分基础公式（短视频）/ 5 层进阶公式（剧情+音频）/ 图生视频专用（只描述运动）。Kling 是 2026 年中文理解最强、原生音画同步、最长 2 分钟、支持角色定向发声、Motion Brush 的电影级模型。用于"用 Kling 生成视频"、"可灵 AI 提示词"、"中文视频生成"、"带原生音频的剧情视频"、"图生视频"、"角色对话视频"等触发场景。

entries.name: model-selector
entries.description: 根据用户的视频需求(场景、时长、音频、语言、平台限制、预算、是否需要本地部署/角色一致性等),从 16 个主流 AI 视频模型(12 商业 + 4 开源)中推荐最匹配的 1-3 个,并解释为什么。覆盖商业:Seedance 2.0、HappyHorse 1.0、Kling 3.0、Sora 2、Veo 3.1、**Gemini Omni**(2026-05 新)、Runway Gen-4.5/Aleph、Pika 2.5、Hailuo 02、Hunyuan Video 1.5、Wan 2.7、即梦 AI;开源:LTX-Video 0.9.7、Mochi 1、CogVideoX 5B、Higgsfield Soul。用于"用哪个 AI 视频模型好"、"Sora 还是 Kling"、"国内有什么模型"、"哪个免费"、"哪个支持中文"、"哪个能编辑已有视频"、"哪个能本地部署"、"哪个角色一致性最强"等触发场景。

entries.name: prompt-translator
entries.description: 把一条 AI 视频提示词从源模型(如 Sora 2)的写法风格转换为目标模型(如 Kling 3.0 / Wan 2.7 / Veo 3.1 等)的最佳实践写法。基于 110 条 10 场景 × 11 模型对照基准数据(prompts/data/cross-model-matrix.json),不是凭直觉重写,而是查表式 in-context learning。10 场景:产品 / 双人对话 / 物理动作 / 图生视频 / 多人会议 / 恐怖 / 自然延时 / 抽象 / 武侠 / 萌宠。用于"Sora 已 EOL 帮我把这条提示词改成 Veo"、"我有 Kling 提示词想跑 Wan"、"跨模型 A/B 测试"、"把英文 prompt 优化成 Kling 中文版"等触发场景。

entries.name: seedance-debugger
entries.description: 诊断 Seedance 2.0 生成视频时出现的常见问题（人物 ID 漂移/双胞胎/字幕/Logo/风格漂移/延长跳变/画质劣化/特效不对/中文发音/音色不准/结尾噪音 等 12 类），定位根因并给出修复后的提示词。用于"我的提示词生成出来不对"、"视频里出现奇怪的字幕"、"人脸不像参考图"、"出现两个一样的人物"、"风格变了"、"怎么修这个提示词"等触发场景。

entries.name: seedance-prompter
entries.description: 把用户的自然语言视频需求转换为符合 Doubao Seedance 2.0 进阶公式的提示词（8 要素：精准主体+动作细节+场景环境+光影色调+镜头运镜+视觉风格+画质+约束条件）。用于"帮我写一个 Seedance 提示词"、"生成视频提示词"、"做个产品广告视频"、"用 Seedance 生成 XX"等触发场景。如果用户没明确说 Seedance，但描述的是单一镜头的复杂叙事/多主体/电影感视频，也优先用此 skill。

entries.name: seedance-storyboard
entries.description: 把复杂剧情/故事大纲拆分为 Seedance 2.0 的"镜头1/镜头2/镜头3"多分镜结构。每个分镜按 4 维度组织（运镜 + 主体动作与表情 + 位置/空间变化 + 音频）。用于"帮我把这个故事写成 Seedance 提示词"、"分镜脚本"、"多镜头视频"、"剧情复杂的视频"、"剧本转分镜"等触发场景。

entries.name: album-dashboard
entries.description: Shows a structured progress dashboard for an album with percentage complete per phase, blocking items, and status breakdown. Use for a quick visual overview of album progress.

entries.name: album-ideas
entries.description: Tracks and manages album ideas including brainstorming, planning, and status updates. Use when the user wants to add, review, or organize their album idea backlog.

entries.name: clipboard
entries.description: Copies track content (lyrics, style prompts, streaming lyrics) to the system clipboard. Use when the user needs to paste lyrics or style prompts into Suno or other external tools.

entries.name: cloud-uploader
entries.description: Uploads promo videos and content to Cloudflare R2 or AWS S3. Use when the user wants to host promo content for social media or distribution.

entries.name: configure
entries.description: Sets up or edits the plugin configuration file interactively. Use on first-time setup, when config is missing, or when the user wants to change settings.

entries.name: document-hunter

entries.name: explicit-checker

entries.name: health-check

entries.name: help
entries.description: Shows available skills, common workflows, and quick reference for the plugin. Use when the user asks for help, what skills are available, or how to do something.

entries.name: import-audio

Use after audio import and before mastering.

Use before generating tracks on Suno or when the user says "pre-gen check" or "ready to generate".

entries.name: promo-director
entries.description: Generates 15-second vertical promo videos for social media from mastered audio. Use after mastering is complete and before release, when the user wants social media content.

entries.name: promo-reviewer
entries.description: Reviews and iterates on social media copy in album promo/ files. Use after populating promo templates and before release to polish platform-specific posts.

entries.name: promo-writer
entries.description: Generates platform-specific social media copy from album themes, track concepts, and lyrics. Use when promo/ templates need to be populated before release.

entries.name: promote-idea
entries.description: Converts an album idea from IDEAS.md into an actual album project in one step. Use when the user says "promote [idea title]", "turn idea into album", or "start working on [idea]".

entries.name: pronunciation-specialist

entries.name: release-director

entries.name: rename

entries.name: researcher
entries.description: Conducts investigative-grade research with primary source analysis, cross-verification, and trial-level depth. Use when an album needs factual research, source material, or verification of claims.

entries.name: researchers-biographical
entries.description: Researches personal backgrounds, interviews, motivations, and humanizing details. Use when research needs biographical context about people involved in the album's subject.

entries.name: researchers-financial

entries.name: resume

entries.name: session-start

entries.name: setup

entries.name: test

entries.name: tutorial

entries.name: validate-album
entries.description: Validates album directory structure, file locations, and content integrity. Use before release or whenever the user wants to check an album's structural health.

entries.name: verify-sources
entries.description: Captures human source verification for tracks, timestamps it, and updates track files. Use when sources need human review before generation.

entries.name: voice-checker
entries.description: Reviews lyrics and prose for AI-written patterns (abstract noun stacking, over-explained metaphors, cliche escalation, missing idiosyncrasy, prose AI tells). Advisory Warning/Info severity — flags issues, does not block or rewrite. Use when reviewing lyrics for authenticity or before generation to catch AI-sounding language.

entries.name: prompt-architect
entries.description: Analyzes and improves prompts using 27 research-backed frameworks across 7 intent categories. Use when a user wants to improve, rewrite, structure, or engineer a prompt — including requests like "help me write a better prompt", "improve this prompt", "what framework should I use", "make this prompt more effective", or any prompt engineering task. Recommends the right framework based on intent (create, transform, reason, critique, recover, clarify, agentic), asks targeted questions, and delivers a structured, high-quality result.
